name: Newton Plaza
summary: Newton Plaza is a thriving community shopping center in Latham, NY, featuring over 35 diverse businesses including popular restaurants, fashion boutiques, specialty shops, and essential services. With highly-rated tenants like Midpoint Artisan Pizza, J McLaughlin, and CVS Pharmacy, this well-established center serves as a convenient neighborhood destination for the Capital District community.
demographics: Newton Plaza serves an affluent suburban demographic in Latham, NY, primarily attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the Capital District region. The trade area draws educated shoppers aged 35-65 with household incomes above the regional median, seeking quality goods and services in a convenient neighborhood setting. Visitors typically engage in multi-purpose shopping trips, combining errands at service providers like banks and pharmacies with dining experiences and specialty retail browsing, reflecting the lifestyle needs of established suburban households.
description: Newton Plaza is a distinguished community shopping center located on Loudon Road in Latham, New York, serving the Capital District with a carefully curated mix of retailers and services. This well-established center has become a neighborhood destination, offering an impressive array of over 35 businesses spanning fine dining, fashion, specialty shops, and essential services. The center's tenant roster reflects its commitment to quality, featuring popular dining destinations like Midpoint Artisan Pizza, Five Guys, Milano, and The Works Cafe, alongside specialty food purveyors including Uncle Sams Candy and Newton Wine & Spirits. Fashion-conscious shoppers can explore Beck's Clothing and Furs, J McLaughlin, Gracies, and the unique Virtue Consignment Boutique, while service needs are met through multiple banking options, CVS Pharmacy, Newton Medical Center, and professional services like DiNapoli Opticians and Jean Paul Salon Spa. With its convenient location, diverse tenant mix, and strong community presence evidenced by its 4.3-star rating from over 850 reviews, Newton Plaza has established itself as an integral part of the Latham retail landscape.
